'''Mount Sardlen''' is a flat-topped hill within the foothills northeast of the [[Damona Mountains|Damona Mountain]] range in [[Murandy]]. It is the nearest hill to the village of [[Hinderstap]]. Travelers on horse can expect to reach Hinderstap from Mount Sardlen within an hour or two. It can be confused with [[Blinder's Peak]] or [[Favlend Mountain]].
